147-1070-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-3967.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4247-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4247-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-1477-3536-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-3536-5131--202.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name the artifact.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat from step 2

2438-2738-4871-5687.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least eight foreshadow counters on it

445-3304.description:
Activate Ominous Seas by removing eight foreshadow counters from it, creating a 8/8 Kraken creature token.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing the Kraken token, drawing eight cards and discarding three cards.
Ominous Seas triggers eight times, putting eight foreshadow counters on itself.
Repeat

3375-4399-4770-7173.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Virulent Emissary trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4770-7173.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4153-6575-7730--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-6575-7730--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

1170-2642-4050-7516.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Adventurous Eater // Have a Bite, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-3259-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3499-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

582-1409-1770.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve both Brazen Freebooter triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

1491-5268-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {1}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Tui and La by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

186-2060-5140-7061.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-5140-7061.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

4038-6723-7008.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2079-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1661-1987-4423-6893.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1021-5231-5412-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-5231-5412-6761.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-5231-5412-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

1339-1887-2122-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-1887-2122-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1741-2713-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1741-2713-5900.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

2060-3129-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-3129-4893-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

803-997-1429-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-997-1429-5402.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2080-2239-4050.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
2080-2239-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

862-4452-5852.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
862-4452-5852.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Crimson Kobolds triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Crimson Kobolds spells, causing the nontoken Crimson Kobolds to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

178-2837-3259.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
The creature with Breath of Fury attached does not have summoning sickness.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Adeline.
178-2837-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Adeline triggers, creating a 2/2 creature token with haste tapped and attacking each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-2777-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Driver of the Dead in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
2292-2777-5326.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1240-1560-2542-3018.manaNeeded: {G/P} equal to twenty times the number of opponents you have, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have
1240-1560-2542-3018.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, or by paying two life due to Defiler of Vigor, targeting Defiler of Vigor.
Defiler of Vigor and Venerated Rotpriest triggers.
Resolve the Defiler of Vigor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Venerated Rotpriest trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Activate Gatherer of Graces by sacrificing Rancor.
Rancor triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Gatherer of Graces ability, regenerating it.
Repeat until each opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.

2590-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
2590-4321.description:
Activate Peregrin Took by sacrificing three Foods.
Experimental Confectioner's second ability triggers three times, creating three 1/1 Rat creature tokens and three Food artifact tokens.
Resolve the Peregrin Took ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2034-2724-3049-3217-3687.notablePrerequisites:
Sophina and at least two other nontoken creatures you control do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2034-2724-3049-3217-3687.description:
Declare Sophina and two other nontoken creatures as attackers.
Sophina triggers, creating three Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
If Wormfang Manta was put onto the battlefield by Havengul Mystery, Havengul Mystery triggers, transforming itself.
Activate the Clue tokens by paying {6}, tapping and sacrificing them, causing you to draw three cards.
At the beginning of your end step, Havengul Laboratory triggers, transforming itself.
Havengul Mystery triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

2100-4306-4456.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to red is at least nine.
2100-4306-4456.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least nine {R}.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Hematite Talisman by paying {3}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

953-1371-2065.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Enter the Infinite.
Resolve each Enter the Infinite, causing each player to draw their entire library, put a card from their hand on top of their library, and have no maximum hand size until their next turn.
At the beginning of each opponent's draw step, Dictate of Kruphix triggers, causing them to draw an additional card and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
